provenance.method: Measured PEM electrolyzer stack power (PSU) and H2 mass flow (FM011, kg/h) during test-stand experiments that followed wind or SIMULATED tidal power profiles. The hydro-electrolyzer README in the repository is a copy of the ADCP README and does not document these experiments.
